title: Prediction: Block or Inline?
prompt:
Predict, then prove. The boilerplate has three elements and empty predictions in CSS comments. Replace each prediction comment with the property that makes the statement true:

1. Make the `.badge` keep its padding AND width while flowing beside the text → set `display` on `.badge`.
2. Make the span-sized `.spacer` disappear entirely → set `display` on `.spacer`.
3. Keep `.para` as a block — but prove it by setting `display` explicitly on `.para`.
boilerplate:
Score: 99 points and counting.

Blocks claim their own line.

tests.name: badge is inline-block
tests.hint: inline keeps width ignored; block breaks the line — the hybrid is inline-block.

tests.name: spacer is none
tests.hint: display: none removes the box entirely — no space, not rendered.

tests.name: para is explicitly block
tests.hint: Paragraphs are block by default — here you state it to prove the concept.
